name: Ibn Tufayl (Abubacer)
shortBio: Andalusian polymath, physician, and vizier; authored Hayy ibn Yaqzan, the philosophical romance exploring empirical tabula rasa, autodidactic reason, and mystical illumination.
centralQuestion: Can an unaided individual on an isolated island independently arrive at scientific, philosophical, and metaphysical truth through pure sensory observation and rational contemplation?

keyWorks.title: Hayy ibn Yaqzan (The Living Son of the Vigilant / Philosophus Autodidactus)
keyWorks.description: Philosophical novel tracing the intellectual and spiritual ascension of a feral human on an uninhabited equatorial island.
